name: Correct lock-mint bridge -- benign hard-negative control
root_cause_summary: No vulnerability. An independent, correct lock->mint bridge used as a benign hard-negative: legitimate deposits lock tokens on the source chain and the faithful relay releases an equal amount of the wrapped token from a relayer-only pool on the destination chain, so the attacker net position is zero under the paired assets and adversarial fuzzing raises no alert. Estimates the oracle false-positive rate on code that is not an exploit.
